_readme: No LLM, no HTTP fetch, no file I/O.
Just sends a plain-text email via Gmail App Password SMTP.
1. Replace authUser / from with your Gmail address
2. Replace authPass with your 16-char Gmail App Password
OR set Railway environment variables and leave config fields empty:
Run via Studio: Import → paste this JSON → Run
Run via API:    POST /runs/inline  { definition: <this JSON> }

config.subject: Hello from wfengine
config.text:
This is a test email sent from the wfengine workflow engine.

If you received this, SMTP is working correctly.
